observed_behavior: The pinned Tooltip.tsx begins with a Tooltip v1 designation and marks both TooltipProps and the Tooltip component with @deprecated. The forwardRef component defaults to a span, uses useId(id) for an element ID, and renders its chosen Component with role='tooltip', aria-label={text}, id={tooltipId} and generated class names for direction, alignment, noDelay and multiline. TooltipContext.Provider exposes the tooltipId through a memoized value, with an in-source comment describing icon-button wrapping detection. Eight compass directions and left/right alignments are assigned as component static arrays. This is specifically the older deprecated component present at the immutable pin.
